meaning:
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;]
1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).
2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Php.2:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
